description: One module registering two: jev-model-router (prompt.submit classifies, turn.step sets the main loop's effort and, off by default, model; agent.spawn sets subagent models) and jev-skill-suggestion (prompt.attachment withholds the skill listing, prompt.submit ranks and reranks skills and attaches the winner, skill.prompt observes and writes /jev-pilot:setup); jev-pet draws Claude the pilot above the prompt (AbovePrompt) with the latest decision, and /jev shows or hides it.
